controls.title: AI system inventory and accountable ownership

ISO/IEC 42001: AI management system context and roles
EU AI Act: Provider/deployer role and system documentation, where applicable

controls.test: Verify inventory record, purpose, named business and technical owners, lifecycle state and review date.

controls.title: AI use-case intake and impact classification

EU AI Act: Risk classification and role-specific applicability, where applicable

controls.test: Sample use cases and confirm documented classification rationale before deployment.

controls.title: Documented risk appetite and risk acceptance
controls.test: Verify delegated authority, rationale, expiry and reassessment for accepted risks.

controls.title: AI policy, standards and workforce awareness
controls.test: Review approved policy version, training completion and exception process.

controls.title: Strong identity, authorization and least privilege
controls.test: Test user, service and tool authorization; verify scoped identities and periodic access review.

controls.title: Threat model and secure architecture review
controls.test: Review trust boundaries, prompt/RAG/tool flows, abuse cases and mitigations.

controls.title: AI application security testing
controls.test: Review adversarial tests, tenant isolation, output handling and remediation evidence.

controls.title: Data governance, minimization and retention

EU AI Act: Data governance requirements for applicable high-risk systems

controls.test: Trace data sources, purpose, permissions, retention, deletion and training-use restrictions.

controls.title: Privacy impact and lawful processing review

EU AI Act: Fundamental rights and data protection interfaces, where applicable

controls.test: Confirm privacy review, lawful basis where relevant, notice, rights handling and DPIA screening.

controls.title: Model provenance, versioning and change approval
controls.test: Verify model source, version, artifact digest, approval and rollback record.

controls.title: Model evaluation, limitations and performance monitoring
controls.test: Review representative evaluation, limitations, thresholds, drift monitoring and response.

controls.title: Model/data supply-chain security
controls.test: Verify trusted source, integrity, dependency review, provenance and promotion controls.

controls.title: Human oversight and escalation

EU AI Act: Human oversight requirements for applicable high-risk systems

controls.test: Test meaningful human review, override, escalation and safe fallback for consequential actions.

controls.title: Third-party AI supplier due diligence

EU AI Act: Provider/deployer and value-chain obligations, where applicable

controls.test: Review supplier security, data use, subprocessors, incident notice, audit rights and exit plan.

controls.title: Operational monitoring, logging and change management
controls.test: Verify security and safety telemetry, protected logs, alert thresholds and change approvals.

controls.title: AI incident response and lessons learned
controls.test: Review AI-specific scenarios, escalation contacts, evidence preservation and exercises.

controls.title: Audit evidence, traceability and periodic control testing
controls.test: Sample control evidence for owner, date, scope, result, integrity and retention.

controls.title: Secure retirement and data/model disposition
controls.test: Verify access revocation, data disposition, artifact retention and user communication.
